events.title: Bitcoin Builders
events.where: "Big Rig" Restaurant Bar, Ogilvie Rd @ Blair, Gloucester
events.about:
A monthly meetup for those creating and building in the Bitcoin space.

Intended for those of us who've been around the Bitcoin space for some time. This meetup is designed for home miners, entrepreneurs, developers, or even content creators, where we can network, share ideas / struggles / successes, and hold each other accountable... but the meetup is certainly open for ANYONE, especially if they can't make it to our Wednesday Bitcoin Basics meetups.

events.title: Bitcoiner Social Meetup

events.about:

Hope to see you there!

events.title: Bitcoin & Coffee
events.where: Marina Dockside Eatery, 1327 Beach Drive, Victoria
events.about:
Casual Bitcoin & Coffee meetup at the Whole Foods coffee shop at Uptown.

Come grab a coffee and chat about Bitcoin with other local bitcoiners. Topics usually range from macro and markets to mining, self-custody, privacy, wallets, security, Bitcoin tech, and whatever else people are interested in that day.

Beginners and longtime bitcoiners are both welcome. No technical knowledge required — if you’re curious about Bitcoin, come say hi.

Please note this is a Bitcoin-focused meetup, not a space for promoting altcoins, memecoins, NFTs, or other “crypto” projects.

events.title: Bitcoin Basics
events.where: The Big Rig Kitchen & Brewery, 115 - 1980 Ogilvie Rd., Ottawa
events.about:
What is Money?

Concerned over rising gas, food, and home prices?

Curious about this "magic internet money" thing that you've heard about from your tech-savvy neighbour? What exactly is Bitcoin? And why have you heard some many conflicting opinions on why it is (or isn't) so important?

Join us for a monthly informal meetup to learn about the money, and the past/present/future of Bitcoin for newcomers.

Brought to you by Bull Bitcoin & Bitcoin Magazine
